name: Semrush
description_en:
Semrush provides search research, configured rank and site monitoring, AI visibility analysis and marketing reports through several toolkits. Semrush One combines SEO and AI search capabilities, while other products and per-user access can require separate purchases. Evaluation starts with the specific data source, monitored target and entitlement rather than treating the entire platform as one unlimited subscription.

For an SEO workflow, distinguish a competitive database estimate, a configured ranking campaign, a technical crawl and a connected analytics measurement. Each has its own collection window and limits. Public documentation currently mixes new and legacy plan names and contains an Advanced prompt-limit conflict; those differences require account-specific confirmation before procurement or migration.
description_zh:
Semrush 通过多个工具包提供搜索研究、自选排名及网站监测、AI 可见度分析和营销报告。Semrush One 组合 SEO 与 AI 搜索能力，其他产品及逐用户访问可能另购。评估应从具体数据源、监测目标和权利开始，不能把整个平台视为单一无限订阅。

在 SEO 工作流中，应区分竞品数据库估算、自选排名任务、技术抓取及已连接的分析测量；它们各有采集窗口和限制。公开文档目前混用新旧套餐名，Advanced 提示词上限也有冲突，采购或迁移前需确认账户实际条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Track selected keywords and targets independently of the broader keyword database.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自选关键词与目标的监测独立于更大关键词数据库。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose crawl source, scope, schedule and rendering settings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择抓取来源、范围、排程及渲染设置。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate brand appearances from citations and configured prompt performance.
core_features.explanation_zh: 区分品牌出现、引用及自选提示词表现。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine connected analytics with Semrush data under report-specific delivery limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按报告交付限制组合已连接分析与 Semrush 数据。

en: Compare a fixed keyword-target panel with technical crawl evidence.
Evaluate AI brand mentions separately from domain citations and measured referrals.
Prepare client reports with explicit source periods, access and recurring costs.
zh: 用固定关键词／目标集合对照技术抓取证据。
分别评估 AI 品牌提及、域名引用及实测引荐。
按明确来源期间、访问及续期成本准备客户报告。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose the specific toolkit and verify current plan and per-user entitlement.
steps.zh: 选择具体工具包，确认当前套餐及逐用户权利。

steps.en: Define the keyword targets and crawl inventory before scheduling work.
steps.zh: 排程前定义关键词目标及抓取清单。

steps.en: Review underlying URLs, answers and widget dates before comparing scores.
steps.zh: 比较分数前核底层 URL、回答及组件日期。

steps.en: Record export, cancellation confirmations and each independent recurring purchase.
steps.zh: 记录导出、取消确认及每项独立续期购买。

items.en: New package names and legacy operational entitlements are not consistently aligned.
items.zh: 新套餐名与旧操作权利尚未一致对应。

items.en: Advanced prompt limits conflict, and standalone AI user access differs from bundled access.
items.zh: Advanced 提示词上限冲突，独立 AI 用户权利与组合方案不同。

items.en: Model estimates, audit readiness and citation presence do not establish business outcomes.
items.zh: 模型估算、抓取准备度及引用出现不能证明业务结果。

items.en: Deletion recovery is tool-specific and must not be assumed.
items.zh: 删除恢复须按工具核实，不能假定可恢复。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current USD cards: SEO$139monthly or$117.33/month billed annually; Starter$199or$165.17; Pro+$299or$248.17. Advanced is custom. SEO/Starter list5websites and500daily keywords; Pro+15/1500; Advanced40+/5000+. Starter/Pro+ list50/100daily prompts. Advanced unlimited-prompts wording conflicts the subscription guide’s200. The$0offer lists one demo project and10daily reports, not unrestricted production monitoring. Other toolkits, seats, reports and API budgets can add cost. Rounded annual equivalents are not verified invoice totals. Tax, checkout currency, trial payment conditions and the exact order were not verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前美元卡：SEO 月付$139，年付折月$117.33；Starter $199／$165.17；Pro+ $299／$248.17；Advanced 定制。SEO／Starter 列5网站、500日跟踪词，Pro+ 15／1500，Advanced 40+／5000+。Starter／Pro+ 列50／100日跟踪提示词；Advanced 无限说法与订阅指南200冲突。$0方案列一个演示项目、每日10报告，不是无限生产监测。其他工具、席位、报告、API 预算可加费。四舍五入折月价不是已核发票年总额；税、结账币种、试用支付条件及具体订单未核。

faq.question_en: Does an AI health score prove that a brand will be cited?
faq.question_zh: AI 健康分能证明品牌会被引用吗？
faq.answer_en: No. It summarizes technical readiness; observed answers and domain citations require separate evidence.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。它总结技术准备度，实际回答及域名引用需另取证。

faq.question_en: Is MCP access the same as every API product?
faq.question_zh: MCP 访问等于全部 API 产品吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Its read-only access and units have explicit plan conditions; Trends and Standard API retain separate terms.
faq.answer_zh: 不等同。其只读访问与积分有明确套餐条件，Trends／Standard API 各有条件。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Database estimates and configured campaigns answer different questions
sections.title_zh: 数据库估算与自选任务回答不同问题
sections.en: Semrush describes keyword databases built from third-party SERP collection, with refreshes ranging from daily to monthly and sometimes longer for smaller databases. Traffic & Market estimates combine clickstream panels and proprietary modeling; they are not a competitor’s directly observed analytics account. Custom Prompt Tracking is daily, while the broader AI dataset is refreshed monthly and Brand Performance weekly. Editorial comparison: preserve the database, geography, tool and snapshot date. A daily campaign label does not make every database row or AI report daily, and modeled visits should not be presented as measured customer sessions.
sections.zh: Semrush 称关键词数据库来自第三方 SERP 采集，按词热度每日到每月刷新，小数据库可能更久。Traffic & Market 结合点击流样本和自有模型估算，不能当作直接看到竞品分析账户。自选 Prompt Tracking 按日，较大的 AI 数据集按月，Brand Performance 按周。编辑比较：保留数据库、地区、工具及快照日期；任务按日不代表每行数据库或每份 AI 报告按日更新，模型访问量不能当作实测客户会话。

sections.title_zh: 按关键词与目标组合计算用量
sections.en: Position Tracking monitors selected terms for a specified engine, geography, device and language. Multitargeting adds variations within a campaign, but the same keyword in another target consumes another keyword unit. Public help still quotes Pro/Guru/Business entitlements while current pricing uses different package names. Editorial setup: write down the exact target matrix, competitor scope and reporting period before importing terms. A position from one location/device is not a universal search position, and a documented legacy allowance should not be silently mapped to a newly named plan.
sections.zh: Position Tracking 按指定引擎、地区、设备和语言监测自选词。Multitargeting 可在同一任务加入目标变体，但同词在另一目标仍另计关键词用量。公开帮助仍列 Pro／Guru／Business 权利，当前价格页已用其他名称。编辑设置：导词前列清目标组合、竞品范围及报告期间；一个地区／设备的位置不是普遍搜索位置，旧套餐额度不能悄然映射到新名套餐。

sections.title_en: Replacing a target can erase the campaign history
sections.title_zh: 替换目标可能清除任务历史
sections.en: The device/location guide says replacing an existing target loses all ranking history. Adding another target can preserve the original campaign’s history when the subscription permits it. Editorial migration: export required records and compare parallel targets before replacement; a target change is not simply a new display filter. Changing a campaign’s scope also changes what later comparisons mean, so retain an explicit change date and avoid treating the resulting discontinuity as an SEO improvement or decline. No campaign was changed in this research.
sections.zh: 设备／地区指南称替换既有目标会丢失全部排名历史；套餐允许时，新增目标可保原任务历史。编辑迁移：替换前导出所需记录并比较并行目标，不能把目标变更当作显示筛选。范围变化也改变后续比较含义，应记录变更日期，不把断点解释为 SEO 改善或下降。本研究未修改任务。

sections.title_en: Visibility and estimated traffic are calculated indicators
sections.title_zh: 可见度和估算流量是计算指标
sections.en: The Overview guide bases Visibility on CTR-weighted positions within the tracked top100: zero means no tracked term ranks there and100% means all are first. Estimated Traffic models daily visits from positions. Average Position assigns100 to an unranked term, while Share of Voice uses search-volume and estimated-traffic weighting rather than simply the keyword count. Editorial reporting: retain the keyword panel and target alongside the score, and keep modeled traffic separate from actual analytics. Predictive growth widgets are scenarios, not guaranteed future visits. Share of Voice entitlement remains plan/version dependent.
sections.zh: Overview 指南按跟踪词前100名中的点击率权重计算 Visibility：零代表均未进范围，100% 代表均第一。Estimated Traffic 按位置估算日访问；Average Position 对未排名词计100，Share of Voice 则按搜索量及估算流量加权，不只是数关键词。编辑报告：分数旁保词集合与目标，并区分模型流量和真实分析数据。增长预测属于情景，不保证未来访问；Share of Voice 权利仍需按套餐／版本确认。

sections.title_zh: 选择可复现的抓取清单
sections.en: Site Audit configuration supports a domain/subdomain/folder scope and Website, robots-linked sitemap, supplied sitemap or uploaded URL file sources. Website discovery follows links breadth first, so it need not cover the most important pages first. The default includes subdomains unless narrowed. Daily, weekly and one-time schedules are distinct from per-audit and monthly page budgets. JavaScript rendering changes the observed content and retains legacy plan conditions in the guide. Editorial acceptance: record the source, exclusions, parameters, user agent and rendering mode; an incomplete crawl cannot establish that unvisited pages are healthy.
sections.zh: Site Audit 可选域／子域／目录范围，以及网页链接、robots 所列 sitemap、指定 sitemap 或上传 URL 文件来源。网页发现按广度优先跟链接，不一定先覆盖最重要页；默认含子域，需主动缩范围。每日、每周及单次排程与单次／月页面预算不同。JavaScript 渲染改变所见内容，指南仍保旧套餐条件。编辑验收：记录来源、排除、参数、代理及渲染模式；不完整抓取不能证明未访问页健康。

sections.title_en: A health score summarizes checks, not search-engine acceptance
sections.title_zh: 健康分数总结检查，不代表搜索引擎接纳
sections.en: Site Health relates detected errors and warnings to performed checks, with errors weighted more strongly. The overview also breaks down healthy, broken, redirected and crawler-blocked pages. AI Search Health is a technical-readiness indicator; blocked-agent reporting concerns observed access rules. These widgets do not prove indexing, AI retrieval, citation or conversion. Editorial triage: inspect the specific URL, issue and live response before changing a site, then rerun comparable coverage. A higher score after excluding difficult pages may reflect a changed denominator rather than a repaired website.
sections.zh: Site Health 将错误／警告与已执行检查关联，错误权重较大，并另列健康、损坏、重定向及抓取受阻页面。AI Search Health 属技术准备度，代理阻挡报告针对观察到的访问规则。这些组件不证明收录、AI 检索、引用或转化。编辑排查：改站前核具体 URL、问题及真实响应，再按可比覆盖复抓。排除难抓页后分数提高，可能只是分母变了，并非网站修好了。

sections.title_en: Keep mentions, citations and topic demand separate
sections.title_zh: 分别解释提及、引用及主题需求
sections.en: AI Visibility is a comparative0–100 benchmark. Mentions count prompts whose answers include the brand; Citations count answers citing its domain. Prompt Research volume is estimated at topic level, not for each individual prompt. Brand Performance Share of Voice compares brand mentions with competitors. Custom Prompt Tracking instead describes citation position and visibility for its selected campaign. Editorial comparison: keep engine, region, brand/domain and prompt panel fixed, inspect underlying answers and avoid converting topic audience estimates into unique visitors. The metrics do not supply one interchangeable measure of brand rank, citation traffic and sales.
sections.zh: AI Visibility 为比较性0–100基准；Mentions 数回答含品牌的提示词，Citations 数引用域名的回答。Prompt Research 搜索量在主题层估算，不是逐条提示词。Brand Performance 的 Share of Voice 比较品牌与竞品提及；自选 Prompt Tracking 则描述该任务中的引用位置和可见度。编辑比较：固定引擎、地区、品牌／域名和提示词集合，查原回答，不把主题受众估计换成独立访客。它们不是可互换的品牌排名、引用流量和销售指标。

sections.title_en: Standalone AI access differs from bundled monitoring
sections.title_zh: 独立 AI 权利与组合监测不同
sections.en: The AI Visibility Toolkit article describes a standalone$99monthly product without a trial, including one brand domain and25tracked prompts. Current Semrush One Starter pricing instead lists50daily prompts. These are different published offer descriptions, not proof of a shared allowance. The subscription guide says the SEO-only package lacks dedicated prompt quotas, AI-ready audit and per-domain brand reporting. Advanced is described as200prompts in that guide but unlimited on the pricing card. Editorial purchase check: obtain the actual order’s product name, prompt pool, engine coverage and user entitlement; the conflict remains unresolved.
sections.zh: AI Visibility Toolkit 文章描述独立产品每月$99、无试用，含一品牌域及25跟踪提示词；当前 Semrush One Starter 价格则列50日跟踪提示词。这是不同的公开方案描述，不能证明共用额度。订阅指南称 SEO 单独套餐无专用提示词额度、AI-ready audit 及逐域品牌报告。该指南写 Advanced 200提示词，价格卡却写无限。编辑采购核查：确认订单产品名、提示词池、引擎覆盖及用户权利；此冲突未解决。

sections.title_en: Ordinary users can also incur seat charges
sections.title_zh: 普通用户也可产生席位费用
sections.en: User Management distinguishes one paying Owner, Users, Admins and external Guests. Admins can edit/delete/share all users’ projects and change ownership. The guide says any existing user can buy extra seats charged to the owner’s payment method, so purchase authority is not limited to admins. Included usage is generally shared, while AI Visibility, Traffic & Market and some apps require separate user access. Editorial onboarding: confirm the seat, role and per-product entitlement independently, allocate limits and review who can invite or purchase. A guest with editing restrictions is not equivalent to a fully entitled teammate.
sections.zh: User Management 区分唯一付款 Owner、User、Admin 及外部 Guest。Admin 可编辑／删除／共享全部用户项目、转所有权。指南称现有普通用户也能买额外席位并扣 Owner 支付方式，购买权不限管理员。包含用量通常共池，但 AI Visibility、Traffic & Market 及部分应用需逐人另购。编辑入职：分别核席位、角色及逐产品权利，分配额度并审邀请／购买权；受编辑限制访客不等于完全获权队员。

sections.title_en: Full Sharing is an optional broad-access setting
sections.title_zh: Full Sharing 是可选的广泛共享设置
sections.en: The sharing guide describes optional Full Sharing to expose assets across the team; without it, users manually share selected assets. Owners and admins retain their broader management visibility. Editorial client delivery: inspect the actual asset and recipient permissions, rather than assuming a team invitation exposes everything or that disabling broad sharing removes every existing manual share. Sharing a project, granting a paid product seat and delivering an external report are different decisions. Review each separately when a person leaves or a client engagement ends. No sharing setting was changed.
sections.zh: 共享指南描述可选 Full Sharing 向全团队开放资产；不开时由用户逐项共享，Owner／Admin 仍有更广管理可见性。编辑客户交付：查真实资产与收件权限，不能假定邀请入队就开放全部，也不能假定关闭广泛共享就撤销全部既有手动共享。共享项目、给予付费产品席位、发送外部报告是不同决定；离职或客户结束时应分别复核。本研究未改共享设置。

sections.title_en: Report pricing and delivery belong to each report
sections.title_zh: 价格与交付条件按每份报告计算
sections.en: My Reports documents Base$10and Pro$20monthly per report. The first paid toolkit includes three Base reports and each additional paid toolkit adds two; these are fixed allocations, not a fresh monthly creation quota. Base offers PDF, scheduling and Semrush-user sharing; Pro adds external integrations, hourly scheduling, branding and link sharing. Paid-product senders can address30recipients versus three for free/trial users. Widget dates can be unlinked from the report date. Editorial acceptance: check each widget’s period and source, the report tier and recipient-facing output; an assembled PDF does not validate its analysis or delivery.
sections.zh: My Reports 按报告月收费，Base $10、Pro $20。首个付费工具包含三份 Base，后续每个付费工具加两份，这是固定持有量，不是每月新增创建额。Base 提供 PDF、排程及 Semrush 用户共享；Pro 增外部集成、小时排程、品牌与链接共享。付费产品发送方最多30收件人，免费／试用为三。组件可脱离报告日期。编辑验收：逐组件核期间／来源、报告档位及收件方输出；生成 PDF 不证明分析或投递有效。

sections.title_en: Standard API, Trends and MCP have different access conditions
sections.title_zh: Standard API、Trends 与 MCP 的访问条件不同
sections.en: The API guide separates Standard Analytics/Projects from Trends. Its legacy Standard access requires the Business SEO add-on and separately purchased recurring unit packs; an upgrade alone supplies no units. Units can depend on the request or returned rows and unused recurring units expire on renewal. Projects API can create, update and delete campaigns, so it is not inherently read-only. Trends is a separate product. Editorial integration: verify the account’s actual API product, authentication, endpoint cost and renewal budget, and preserve project identifiers before permitting mutation. Current Advanced marketing does not by itself establish a funded legacy API balance.
sections.zh: API 指南区分 Standard Analytics／Projects 与 Trends。其旧 Standard 条件为 Business SEO 附加项并另购续期积分包，仅升级不送积分；用量可按请求或返回行计，续期时未用的定期积分到期。Projects API 可创建、更新、删除任务，本身不是只读。Trends 另属产品。编辑集成：核账户真实 API 产品、认证、端点成本和续费预算，允许写操作前保项目标识。当前 Advanced 营销描述本身不能证明已有旧 API 可用余额。

sections.title_en: MCP read-only access still consumes its own API budget
sections.title_zh: MCP 只读访问仍消耗自身 API 预算
sections.en: The MCP guide describes OAuth/API-key connections with read-only retrieval. It lists50,000renewal-cycle MCP units for Semrush One Starter/Pro+ and SEO Classic Pro/Guru, while Advanced/Classic Business require a package. Traffic/market access requires Trends API separately. Queries consume units, and narrowing result counts, database and filters matters. Editorial assistant workflow: retain the requested scope and source timestamp, check the unit balance and inspect returned evidence before presenting generated conclusions. A connector does not grant every Semrush dataset, make estimates first-party analytics or establish that the assistant’s interpretation is correct. No connection or request was executed.
sections.zh: MCP 指南描述 OAuth／API key 连接，只读取数。Semrush One Starter／Pro+ 与 SEO Classic Pro／Guru 列每续期周期50,000 MCP 积分；Advanced／Classic Business 需积分包。流量／市场数据另需 Trends API。查询消耗积分，结果条数、数据库与筛选范围都影响用量。编辑助手工作流：保请求范围及来源时间，核余额，审返回证据后再呈结论。连接器不授予全部数据集，不会把估算变第一方分析，也不证明助手解释正确。本研究未连接或调用。

sections.title_en: Deleting a shared monitoring project affects other tools
sections.title_zh: 删除监测项目会影响其他工具
sections.en: Deleting a monitoring project affects its other configured tools. Site Audit warns of irreversible loss; Position Tracking describes conditional Support restoration. Recovery is therefore not established universally. Editorial cleanup: inventory campaigns/owners, export needed records and confirm the deletion scope. No deletion or recovery was performed.
sections.zh: Position Tracking 与 Site Audit 文档将任务删除关联到外围 Website Monitoring 项目，会影响其中其他已配置工具。Site Audit 警告删除后不可恢复，Position Tracking 则描述有条件支持恢复，不能据此确定所有工具／套餐均能恢复。编辑清理：删除前盘全部任务及所有者，导出所需记录并确认具体范围，不把看似无用的排名任务当孤立图表删除。本研究未删除或恢复。

sections.title_en: Submitting a cancellation form is not the final billing state
sections.title_zh: 提交取消表单不是最终账单状态
sections.en: Cancellation requires the logged-in form and its email confirmation link within24hours; otherwise billing continues. Verify the final completion email and Recurring:Inactive status. Toolkits, Apps and add-ons have separate routes; some extras need Support. Editorial exit: inventory recurring purchases and preserve final confirmations. Submitting a form or removing a teammate does not establish cancellation. Trials can convert to paid.
sections.zh: 取消指南要求登录填完整表单，并在24小时内点击邮件确认链接，否则继续计费；之后以最终完成邮件及 Recurring:Inactive 状态确认。多个工具包、应用及附加项有各自路径，部分额外项需支持处理。编辑退出：列全部续期产品，保确认并核真实最终订阅状态；不能因填表未回应、不使用或移除队员就推定已取消。试用可按其条件转付费。

sections.title_en: Paid-access loss has a limited monitoring grace period
sections.title_zh: 失去付费访问后的监测宽限期有限
sections.en: The exit guide gives30days to renew and restore Website Monitoring; afterward only the oldest project remains under free limits. Add-ons carry into upgrades unless removed first with confirmation. Editorial transition: export required records with target/history context before access ends. Cancellation differs from account deletion. The grace period does not establish indefinite retention; complete-export coverage and long-term recovery remain unverified.
sections.zh: 退出指南描述可在30天内续费恢复 Website Monitoring 访问，此后仅最旧项目按免费限制保留；既有附加项若未先移除，会随升级继续，需确认。编辑切换：付费访问结束前导出连续工作所需记录，区分逐产品取消和删账户，并随导出保目标／历史背景。宽限期及免费账户都不能证明全部项目、报告、集成无限保留。完整导出覆盖及长期恢复未核。

seo.title_en: Semrush: rank targets, audits, AI visibility, reports and API budgets
seo.title_zh: Semrush：排名目标、抓取、AI 可见度、报告及 API 预算
seo.description_en: Evaluate Semrush monitoring scope, AI metrics, team access, report tiers, metered integrations and cancellation from official documentation.
seo.description_zh: 按官方文档评估 Semrush 监测范围、AI 指标、团队访问、报告档位、计量集成及取消。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Semrush documented monitoring and reporting workflows
secondary_questions: Do target changes preserve ranking history?
How do AI mentions differ from citations?
Which access and API units are shared?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.
